setting.note: A conspiracy of nihilists tears through an unnamed Russian provincial town over a few feverish weeks around 1870, from the governor's drawing rooms to a country estate and a murder in the park.

rights.originalWork: Public domain. Fyodor Dostoevsky, first published 1871–72; the author died in 1881. Mapped here as a cited work: we store none of its text and reproduce no passages. The places are facts and the notes are our own.

palette.note: The bruised violet of a provincial town possessed by its own bad ideas. A muted, feverish tone that clears WCAG AA on paper.
